# 🚀 Day 03 - Functions, Modules & Exception Handling

Welcome to **Day 03** of the **45-Day AI/ML Engineer Bootcamp**.

This day focuses on writing reusable code using functions, organizing code with modules, and handling runtime errors using exception handling.

---

# 📚 Topics Covered

- Functions
- Parameters & Arguments
- Return Statement
- Default Arguments
- Keyword Arguments
- *args
- **kwargs
- Lambda Functions
- Recursion
- Python Modules
- Math Module
- Random Module
- Datetime Module
- Exception Handling
- try, except, else & finally
- raise Keyword

# 🎯 Learning Outcomes

By completing Day 03, you will be able to:

- Create reusable functions
- Use different types of function arguments
- Apply lambda functions and recursion
- Work with Python's built-in modules
- Handle exceptions using try-except blocks
- Build interactive Python applications
